Qubit-added typed policy-refusal helper: parses the backend's typed denied envelope (code, detail, qubit_counterpart) so dashboard actions render honest guidance instead of a raw error (no upstream counterpart).

Qubit-added contract test for the /docs OpenAPI reference (drift A23): renders the served OAS operations grouped by namespace and narrowed by the header search input.
Qubit-added contract test for the /env six-tab surface (drift A22): every section is structural with an empty catalog and each header tab jumps to its card.

Qubit-added contract test for the /models provider-profile 'Use as' actions (drift A20): one action per profile, aria-pressed on the active one, and a click routed through the canonical setActiveProfile op.
Qubit-added contract test for the /skills category filter and live header search (drift A21), including the typed empty state when nothing matches.

Qubit-added authenticated SSE reader for the single Qubit event path (`GET /api/events/stream`, served by `voicebridge/webui.py:_events_stream`): fetch + ReadableStream/TextDecoder frame parser (because `EventSource` cannot attach the dashboard auth header), `?last_seq=` journal replay cursor, id/event/data frames, comment heartbeats, and the `resync` overflow sentinel. No upstream counterpart: the vendored sidebar used WebSockets, which Qubit refuses with HTTP 426 `WS_SINGLE_PATH`.

Qubit-added unit test for the SSE frame parser and replay-URL builder (partial-tail buffering, heartbeat/retry-block filtering, multi-line data joins, the resync sentinel, and base-path/cursor handling).

Qubit-added canonical chat-route predicate (owner chat mapping): `/chat` and `/qubit-chat` are the two equivalent chat routes rendering the single shared ChatPage host. Qubit-added unit test for the canonical chat-route predicate (both routes match, trailing slash tolerated, prefix collisions rejected).

provenance_schema.purpose: Per-file provenance for every vendored Hermes/OpenClaw file. Unmodified source stays byte-identical; every divergence is a documented Qubit patch with a regression test.

fields.upstream_blob_sha256: sha256 of the pinned upstream blob content; identical to upstream_sha256 (kept for the dashboard-rebuild contract wording). null when the file has no upstream counterpart.
fields.qubit: vendored local path (or null when intentionally omitted)
fields.qubit_sha256: sha256 of the on-disk vendored file
fields.patch: exact patch id / rebrand description; null when the vendored file is byte-identical to upstream
fields.reason: why the patch/add exists and what behaviour it affects
fields.affected_regression_test: on-disk test that fails if the divergence or provenance record regresses

provenance_schema.added_files: Qubit-authored files with no upstream counterpart live under wave3.added / wave4.added, each with qubit_sha256, role, and affected_regression_test.
